{"bugs_found":["test_item returns Result.success(index - 1, item) instead of index + 1, violating the operator-level invariant that consuming one item must advance the index by exactly 1; this also breaks test_char, match_item, char_from, any_char, letter, digit, decimal_digit, and consequently any parser built on them","Parser.__mul__ with a range argument calls self.times(other.start, other.stop - 1), but the contract states range.stop is exclusive so max should be other.stop - 1 only when interpreting inclusively; combined with times semantics this off-by-one yields max one less than intended (e.g. range(1,4) parses at most 3 times per contract but code passes max=3 which with times' 'times < max' loop allows up to 3 — acceptable; however range(1,2) becomes times(1,1) excluding the documented upper bound)"],"verdict":"REQUEST_CHANGES"}
